jobs.title: Corporate FP&A Manager
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

We are seeking a strategic, hands on Corporate FP&A Manager to join our team and report to our FP&A leader. This high-impact role owns regular budgeting and forecasting cycles, select enterprise-wide expense forecasts, and partners strongly with finance leaders on the Long Range Plan and burn and runway projections. You will manage and develop a team of FP&A Business Partners, enabling strong departmental partnership while driving the company-wide process, cadence and elevating the quality bar.



As Planful Super Admin, you will own system administration and lead initiatives to streamline and automate forecasting while ensuring reliable execution of current processes. You will partner with finance and executive leadership to provide accurate, actionable visibility and scale the function as Onebrief grows.



We are looking for someone to bring structure to ambiguity, communicate clearly, and take full ownership from planning through execution. This role will improve and automate manual processes while ensuring they continue to run reliably until the new solution is in place. We are looking for someone curious and collaborative, that can operate effectively as a player-coach in a scaling organization.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Company-Wide Expense Budgeting and Forecasting: Own the end-to-end planning process, coordinating FP&A Business Partners' departmental inputs into a cohesive, accurate company plan. Own select enterprise-wide expense forecasts (eg. benefits).

 - Ensure Financial Data Integrity: Partner with Accounting to establish controls and validations across the systems (ERP/HR/RevRec/Planful) to ensure consistent and reliable data.

 - Own Forecast Performance and Management Reporting: Lead monthly management reporting, including forecast and budget to actual variance analysis, forecast accuracy, key business drivers, risks, and opportunities, and develop executive ready materials that translate financial performance into clear insights and recommended actions.

 - Drive Process Automation & Streamlining: Lead high-impact projects to streamline and automate expense forecasting, improving accuracy, speed, and scalability across planning tools, integrations, visualization and financial infrastructure.

 - Maintain and Evolve the Long Range Plan: Partner with stakeholders to continuously develop and enhance Onebrief's existing 3-statement Long Range Plan as strategy, growth assumptions, and scenario-planning needs evolve.

 - Own Balance Sheet and Short-Term Cash Flow Forecasting: Forecast the balance sheet, cash flow, burn, and runway to provide leadership with clear visibility into the company's financial trajectory.

 - Administer Planful and Financial Data Hierarchies: Serve as Planful Super Admin, owning system configuration, security, access, workflows, templates, and troubleshooting while maintaining scalable, consistent hierarchies across the chart of accounts, departments, entities, and other dimensions.

 - Lead the FP&A Business Partner Team: Manage and develop the team, establish standards for departmental expense modeling, variance analysis, planning cadence, stakeholder support and cross functional partnership.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of FP&A (Corporate preferred and/or Business Partnering) experience, preferably in high-growth SaaS environment, including company-wide planning and 1-2 years of experience managing a team.

 - Proven experience evolving a three statement Long Range Plan and owning balance sheet, short term cash flow, burn, and runway forecasts.

 - A track record of improving and automating FP&A processes while maintaining reliable day-to-day execution and balancing strategic ownership with hands on work in a fast paced environment.

 - Hands-on administration experience with Planful or a similar FP&A platform, ideally as a Super Admin. Experience maintaining financial data hierarchies across the chart of accounts, departments, cost centers, and entities.

 - Advanced Excel skills and knowledge of SaaS metrics, including ARR, NRR, Rule of 40, CAC, CLTV, gross margin, and retention.

 - Experience creating executive ready materials and translating complex analysis into concise, actionable insights, with clear verbal and written communication, exceptional organization, attention to detail, and self directed ownership of competing work streams through completion with minimal oversight.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Corporate FP&A Manager will:

 - Owns their work end-to-end with minimal oversight, taking full accountability for outcomes

 - Communicates clearly and concisely — able to translate fluently between financial detail and business-level thinking

 - Adaptable across FP&A hats today, with the perspective — from both startup and larger-company experience — to help the function specialize as we scale


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Onebrief is expanding its global footprint across international defense and operational sectors, requiring a disciplined, high-impact partner ecosystem to unlock strategic commercial, technical, and delivery capabilities. As an International Partnerships Manager, you will take ownership of making priority partnerships productive across assigned international markets, translating strategic alliances into measurable customer outcomes.


In this role, you will establish accountable partner execution in close lockstep with International Growth and regional Sales teams. You will focus on building repeatable, high-value partner models that directly support regional opportunity targets, drive customer adoption, and enhance product delivery across diverse international defense landscapes.


Operating as a deep functional individual contributor expert, you will guide our international partnership strategy through a structured validation model: proving initial value through verified deal contributions, demonstrating cross-customer repeatability through standardized processes, and building data-driven business cases to invest against operational constraints. You will directly shape how Onebrief scales globally alongside our international allies and partners.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Establish Accountable Regional Execution: Lead the end-to-end execution of priority international partnerships across assigned regions, aligning closely with International Growth and regional Sales leadership to achieve agreed opportunity and revenue targets.

 - Activate Partner Capabilities: Identify, activate, and integrate commercial, technical, and delivery capabilities from priority partners into live customer opportunities and Onebrief deployment workflows, ensuring contributions are validated by Sales and technical owners.

 - Build Repeatable Partnership Models: Design and implement scalable, standardized partnership frameworks and operational processes from scratch that replace one-off solutions and ensure consistent, efficient execution across multiple customer accounts.

 - Drive Constraint-Based Scaling & Strategy: Perform in-depth analysis of partner performance and market friction, collaborating with cross-functional leadership and Finance at key review milestones (6- and 12-month marks) to build rigorous business cases for scaling, holding, adjusting, or expanding market coverage.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Domain Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience in partnership management, alliance development, or strategic Go-To-Market (GTM) execution, with deep expertise operating within international markets, defense technology, enterprise SaaS, or complex government sectors.

 - Zero to One Partnership Strategy: Proven experience building partnership strategies from the ground up, including identifying priority markets and partners, securing initial partnerships, and creating a repeatable approach to scale.

 - Functional Thought Leadership: Proven track record of leveraging subject matter expertise to set functional direction and design advanced, scalable solutions for highly complex, multi-variable international GTM challenges.

 - Interpretive Problem-Solving: Demonstrated capability to perform in-depth analysis and use interpretive thinking to define ambiguous operational challenges, evaluate complex alternatives, and deploy innovative partnership frameworks.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional ability to lead through expertise and influence across distributed teams, including International Growth, Sales, Product, Technical, and Finance, shaping strategy across organizational boundaries without direct authority.

 - Rigorous Execution & Validation: Track record of establishing metric-driven partnership models that deliver verified commercial pipeline, specialized technical capabilities, or customer delivery success.

 - Executive Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the presence and clarity required to represent Onebrief to senior international military, government, enterprise, and coalition leaders.

 - Willingness and ability to travel: This role requires domestic and international travel 50% to 75% of the time to meet with prospective customers. Candidates must have a valid passport or be able to obtain one promptly.

 - Security Clearance: Willingness and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance if required for the role.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience working within defense technology ecosystems, military planning workflows, or international allied frameworks (e.g., NATO, FVEY, or regional defense alliances).

 - Proven success building and scaling international channel, technical integration, or co-selling partner models from early growth phases into scalable global programs.

 - Direct experience managing international business development across target regions in Europe, Asia-Pacific, or the Middle East, including knowledge of regional procurement processes.

 - Background operating within high-growth, venture-backed technology environments scaling complex GTM and partner organizations.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months. A successful International Partnerships Manager will:

 - Establish accountable partnership execution plans across assigned international markets, fully aligned with International Growth and regional Sales pipeline targets.

 - Successfully activate initial priority partners to deliver verified commercial, technical, or delivery capabilities accepted by regional Sales and technical owners on live opportunities.

 - Codify a repeatable partner engagement model across multiple customer opportunities, eliminating one-off deal mechanics and establishing standardized workflows.

 - Conduct a thorough 6-month partnership review with cross-functional leadership and Finance, delivering clear data on partner productivity and actionable strategy adjustments.

 - Identify specific operational constraints across target international markets and build data-backed recommendations for where and when to allocate future partnership capacity.




TOOLS, SYSTEMS & TECHNOLOGIES

 - CRM & Pipeline Tools (Salesforce, HubSpot)

 - Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platforms

 - Onebrief Platform

 - Modern Collaboration Suites (Slack, Notion, Jira, Confluence)


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies

In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

As Head of Growth at Onebrief, you will lead our effort to build the future of military decision-making within the U.S. Navy. You’ll develop and execute strategic plans to drive growth and market expansion in alignment with the company’s mission and objectives. You’ll also conduct market research and analysis to identify new business opportunities, emerging trends, and competitive threats.

You will leverage your background and existing connections to build and nurture relationships with key stakeholders, including government agencies, military organizations, industry partners, and potential clients. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to align growth initiatives with overall business objectives and ensure successful execution.

You will provide leadership, guidance, and mentorship to the growth, customer relations, engineering, and marketing teams to achieve growth targets and foster a culture of continuous improvement.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Core responsibilities:

 - You will lead the development of marketing and sales initiatives to engage with Navy Program Acquisition Executives, generate leads, increase brand awareness, and develop insights that support expansion within existing customers and demonstrate impact.

 - You will establish performance metrics and KPIs to track progress, evaluate the effectiveness of growth initiatives, and make data-driven decisions.

 - Direct resourcing and strategic goals for a team of Business Development Executives, balancing account complexity and expansion timelines.

 - Stay informed about industry developments, congressional events, and key partnerships to anticipate challenges and capitalize on opportunities.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years of experience in U.S. Navy, DoW, defense technology, or government-focused growth/business development, with a demonstrated track record of expanding relationships and revenue within government organizations.

 - Deep understanding of the U.S. Navy and its organizational structure, including major operational commands, OPNAV, Fleet Forces, systems commands, and the acquisition and budgeting processes that influence technology adoption.

 - Proven track record of growing enterprise relationships and revenue within the U.S. Government, including identifying expansion opportunities, developing account strategies, and converting customer relationships into new programs or contracts.

 - Experience selling or deploying software, technology, or mission-critical capabilities to Navy or DoW customers, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling operational and mission outcomes.

 - Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior military and civilian leaders, while also developing trusted relationships with operators, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and contracting organizations.

 - Demonstrated ability to develop and execute a Navy-focused growth strategy, balancing near-term expansion within existing customers with longer-term market development and new customer acquisition.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Prior experience selling or scaling a software or technology product across multiple U.S. Navy organizations, with a demonstrated ability to turn successful deployments into broader adoption.

 - Strong understanding of the U.S. Navy and Department of War, with familiarity across operational, acquisition, and strategic organizations and the roles of senior military and civilian decision-makers.

 - Experience developing and managing complex, multi-year growth strategies, including account mapping, pipeline development, capture strategy, strategic partnerships, and expansion across large government accounts.

 - Experience operating at the intersection of mission, technology, and government acquisition, with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable product, go-to-market, and growth strategies while maintaining strong alignment with Product and Customer Relations teams.




INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Head of Growth, Navy will:

 - Drive quarterly and annual revenue results that meet or exceed benchmarks outline by the Chief Revenue Officer.

 - Build deep relationships with Service, Command, and Program Acquisition Executive representatives.

 - Construct and maintain a direct sales pipeline with sufficient coverage to achieve company goals.

 - Integrate Navy-related direct sales actions with marketing, capture, and customer relations activities.

 - Lead the Navy Vertical team to achieve company and Chief Revenue Officer goals.
